purpose: Explicit task-profile projection of the frozen public extraction rules; contains no gold targets, groups, contrasts, reviews, or private mappings.

conditionalRepresentation.root: first primary action in the main clause
conditionalRepresentation.consequences: remaining coordinated actions as nested consequences of the root
conditionalRepresentation.conditionAttachment: condition attaches to the root conditional clause

allow.theme: the object or resource acted on
allow.action: the permitted action as a registered predicate identifier; abstain if no registered predicate expresses it
allow.agent: the stated permitter/authority; never the permitted party

prohibit.theme: the object or resource acted on
prohibit.action: the forbidden action as a registered predicate identifier; abstain if no registered predicate expresses it
prohibit.agent: the stated permitter/authority; never the permitted party

encodingPolicy.explicitQuantityUnit: preserve exactly; for seven times use {type: quantity, value: 7, unit: times}

modalityPolicy: obligation and permission are distinct; preserve explicit modality on root and coordinated consequences; lexical negation uses negated=true; "X is permitted to Y" / "X may Y" with no stated permitter is modality permission on Y, not allow

abstentionPolicy.missingRequiredFrameArgument: unsupported: abstain when the source does not state a role the frame requires; never fill it with the role's type name or the verb (core rejects this as placeholder_role)

derivation: Frame lunum-frame/0.3 (decisions/0010): allow/prohibit with an action require a distinct stated recipient. V8 is in-sample (the rule was written after V8 g2 rows failed).

roleDefaultTypes._rule: When the source gives only a bare identifier with no typing noun, use the role default below.
roleDefaultTypes.below.subject: metric
roleDefaultTypes.above.subject: metric
